'''Edward Fones''' (who signed his forum posts '''Edward Carl Fones'''; Players Committee forum handle '''ecf''')<ref name="pcf-3806-52035">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52035#52035 GenCon Questions], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106003332/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52091%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player and tournament organizer from Oregon. He won the [[2004 Oregon State Championship]], played on Saturday 19 June 2004 in Beaverton, Oregon:<ref name="pcf-3383-46989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46989#46989 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall (glenn.hall), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210617/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47102%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> after finishing second in the six-game tournament with four wins and one loss, he won both games of the final confrontation against Noah Frank.<ref name="pcf-3383-47778">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47778#47778 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Player ==

In November 2003 [[David Kangas]] placed Fones in Central Oregon (Prineville),<ref name="pcf-2442-37471">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=37471#37471 Looking for OR/WA players or tourneys], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040323101525/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2442%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and [[Kyle Krueger]] pointed players looking for Oregon tournaments to Fones and Kangas.<ref name="pcf-2442-37497">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=37497#37497 Looking for OR/WA players or tourneys], Kyle Krueger (Meto), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040323101525/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2442%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Fones played in about five to seven [[Classic]] events in 2003, including the Classic event at the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-2289-34893">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34893#34893 x], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050102220511/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34880%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

At the [[2004 World Championship]] he intended to play an [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] deck on Day 2.<ref name="pcf-4071-55486">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55486#55486 You will be missed...], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041226191332/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55465%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In his resignation post of 25 October 2004, David Kangas named Fones first among "some of the best players this game has never know[n]".<ref name="pcf-4063-55368">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55368#55368 State of the PC Address: So long and thanks for all the fish], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050228234323/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55374%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organizer ==

With David Kangas, Fones planned and ran the ''Star Wars'' CCG events at [[2004 GameStorm|GameStorm]], a gaming convention in Portland, Oregon, on 5–7 March 2004; he posted the convention hotel's address and the event schedule.<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" /><ref name="pcf-2668-40210">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40210#40210 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2668-40480">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40480#40480 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

He announced an open-format tournament at NetGamerZ in Vancouver, Washington, for 7 August 2004,<ref name="pcf-3659-49965" /> and in September 2004 a Salem player wrote that Fones had been running tournaments in Vancouver.<ref name="pcf-3958-54048">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54048#54048 Southern WA ( vancouver ) or Metro Portland ( OR )], Moogle, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041103164727/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54225%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> That month Fones wrote that he lived three hours away from most of the Portland and Vancouver venues but was looking to run one event a month;<ref name="pcf-3958-54104">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54104#54104 Southern WA ( vancouver ) or Metro Portland ( OR )], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041103164727/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54225%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> in October 2004 he asked local players whether 15 or 16 October suited them better for an event.<ref name="pcf-3958-54903">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54903#54903 Southern WA ( vancouver ) or Metro Portland ( OR )], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041103164727/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54225%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

For the [[2005 Endor Regional]] weekend at Addictive Behaviors in downtown Eugene, Oregon, Fones posted the store and travel details and the schedule of events for 22–24 October 2004: ''Star Wars'' CCG and [[WARS TCG]] sealed, booster draft and constructed events around the regional itself on Saturday 23 October, and a "Super Secret Squirrel" event that evening.<ref name="pcf-3974-54272">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272#54272 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3974-54735">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54735#54735 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Afterwards he thanked the ten people who came to the weekend, and wrote that he would not be surprised if neither the Washington nor the Oregon state championship were held in 2005.<ref name="pcf-3974-55369">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55369#55369 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
